fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Sprints 7 tiles to an enemy and deals 14 damage, up to 2.2 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Hare Nip
fusions.desc: Nips for 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Flat Out
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with 10% more dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Coursing Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded lurcher runs down enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
